en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a villa-style building with a sign reading 'Continental' on the facade. The building is surrounded by lush trees and gardens, suggesting a tranquil and possibly spa-town setting. The handwritten text at the bottom appears to say 'Gruß Continental - Bad Pyrmont.' The reverse side of the postcard has pre-printed lines for address, a logo for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' and printed publisher information.
